title: The and a/an (2)
summary: Нулевой артикль и особые случаи: обобщения во множественном числе и с неисчисляемыми, абстрактные понятия, приёмы пищи, school / hospital / work / home, by + транспорт, времена года и суток, названия газет, языков, титулов, а также a/an с абстрактными существительными.
ru:
## Нулевой артикль: обобщения
Когда мы говорим о **категории в целом**, а не о конкретных предметах, артикля нет: перед **множественным числом** и **неисчисляемыми** существительными.
> **Children** need sleep. — Детям нужен сон.
> **Coffee** is grown in many countries. — Кофе выращивают во многих странах.
> **Honesty** matters more than talent. — Честность важнее таланта.
Сравните с конкретными: ***The** children in this class are very quiet.* — именно эти дети. *I like **the** coffee you made.* — именно этот кофе.
Частая ошибка русскоязычных — ставить the перед абстрактным понятием: ~~The life is hard.~~ → **Life** is hard. ~~The nature is beautiful.~~ → **Nature** is beautiful. Но с уточнением артикль появляется: *the life of an artist, the nature of the problem*.

## Абстрактные существительные с a/an
Неисчисляемые абстрактные слова обычно без артикля, но когда есть **оценка или описание**, можно ставить **a/an**:
> She has **a** deep **knowledge** of Asian art. — У неё глубокие знания об азиатском искусстве.
> He showed **a** great **respect** for the rules. / He showed great respect.
> I have **an** understanding of the situation. / We need **a** better **understanding** of risk.

## Приёмы пищи, времена суток, года
- **Meals**: *have breakfast, after lunch, at dinner*. Но если есть описание или оценка: *We had **a** wonderful breakfast. **The** dinner at his house was excellent.*
- **Времена года**: *in spring, in winter* (без артикля) — или *in the spring* (особенно с конкретным уточнением: *in the spring of 2019*).
- **Времена суток**: *at night, at noon, at midnight, by day* без артикля; но *in the morning, in the evening, in the afternoon* — с **the**.
- **Дни и месяцы**: *on Monday, in June, last Friday*.

## school, hospital, church, prison, bed, work, home
Если учреждение используется по **основному назначению**, артикля нет. Если речь о здании как о месте — **the**:
> The children are **at school**. — Дети учатся (в школе).
> I went to **the school** to talk to a teacher. — Я зашёл в здание школы (не учиться).
> He's **in prison** (сидит); *the lawyer went to **the prison*** (был в здании).
> **go to bed, go to work, go home, be at home, in class, at sea, by heart**.

## by + транспорт
Способ передвижения: **by car, by bus, by train, by plane, by bike**. Но с конкретным предметом: *on **the** bus, in **a** taxi, in **my** car*. Сравните: *I go to work **by** bus.* / *I met her **on the** bus.* Пешком: *on foot*.

## Названия, титулы, языки
- **Языки**: *Russian, English* — без артикля, но *the Russian language*.
- **Национальности** (группа): *the French, the English* (мн. число).
- **Титулы**: **President Kennedy, Doctor Brown, Professor Lee** — без артикля при имени; **the President, the doctor** — без имени.
- **Названия газет**: *The Times, The Guardian* — с the; журналы: *Vogue* (обычно без).
- **Улицы, площади, парки**: *Oxford Street, Red Square, Central Park* — без артикля. Но *the Strand, the Bronx*.
- **Даты, десятилетия**: *in the 1990s, in the nineties*.

## Особые случаи
- **all / both / half + the**: *all the students* (конкретные), но *all students* (в целом); *both the girls* / *both girls*; *half the time* / *half of the time*.
- **such / quite / rather / what / half + a/an**: *such a pity, quite a few, rather an odd idea, what a surprise, half an hour*. Артикль ставится **после** этих слов.
- **a + имя собственное**: *a Picasso* (картина), *a Mr Brown* (некий господин Браун), *a Ford* (автомобиль).
- **Части тела** вместо притяжательного: *He took me **by the** arm. She hit him **on the** head.*

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~The Russian is a difficult language.~~ → **Russian** is a difficult language.
- ~~The breakfast is the most important meal.~~ → **Breakfast** is the most important meal.
- ~~I go to the work by the bus.~~ → I go to **work** by **bus**.
- ~~He went to the prison to visit his friend, and now he is in the prison himself.~~ → ...and now he is **in prison** himself.
- ~~It was the such good film.~~ → It was **such a** good film.
en:
## Zero article: generalisations
When we talk about a **category in general**, not about particular things, there is no article before **plural** and **uncountable** nouns.
> **Children** need sleep.
> **Coffee** is grown in many countries.
> **Honesty** matters more than talent.
Compare with specific ones: ***The** children in this class are very quiet.* *I like **the** coffee you made.*
A common mistake is to put *the* before an abstract noun: ~~The life is hard.~~ → **Life** is hard. ~~The nature is beautiful.~~ → **Nature** is beautiful. With a restriction the article appears: *the life of an artist, the nature of the problem*.

## Abstract nouns with a/an
Uncountable abstract nouns usually have no article, but with a **description or evaluation** we can use **a/an**:
> She has **a** deep **knowledge** of Asian art.
> He showed **a** great **respect** for the rules. / He showed great respect.
> We need **a** better **understanding** of risk.

## Meals, times of day, seasons
- **Meals**: *have breakfast, after lunch, at dinner*. But with a description: *We had **a** wonderful breakfast. **The** dinner at his house was excellent.*
- **Seasons**: *in spring, in winter* (no article) — or *in the spring* (especially with a specific reference: *in the spring of 2019*).
- **Parts of the day**: *at night, at noon, at midnight* with no article, but *in the morning, in the evening, in the afternoon* with **the**.
- **Days and months**: *on Monday, in June, last Friday*.

## school, hospital, church, prison, bed, work, home
When we use the place for its **main purpose**, there is no article. If we mean the building, we use **the**:
> The children are **at school**.
> I went to **the school** to talk to a teacher.
> He's **in prison**; *the lawyer went to **the prison***.
> **go to bed, go to work, go home, be at home, in class, at sea, by heart**.

## by + transport
**by car, by bus, by train, by plane, by bike**. But with a particular vehicle: *on **the** bus, in **a** taxi, in **my** car*. *I go to work **by** bus.* / *I met her **on the** bus.* On foot: *on foot*.

## Names, titles, languages
- **Languages**: *Russian, English* — no article, but *the Russian language*.
- **Nationalities** (groups): *the French, the English* (plural).
- **Titles**: **President Kennedy, Doctor Brown, Professor Lee** — no article with the name; **the President, the doctor** without it.
- **Newspapers**: *The Times, The Guardian* — with the; magazines: *Vogue* (usually without).
- **Streets, squares, parks**: *Oxford Street, Red Square, Central Park* — no article. But *the Strand, the Bronx*.
- **Dates, decades**: *in the 1990s, in the nineties*.

## Special cases
- **all / both / half + the**: *all the students* (specific), but *all students* (in general); *both the girls* / *both girls*; *half the time*.
- **such / quite / rather / what / half + a/an**: *such a pity, quite a few, rather an odd idea, what a surprise, half an hour*. The article goes **after** these words.
- **a + proper name**: *a Picasso* (a painting), *a Mr Brown* (some Mr Brown), *a Ford* (a car).
- **Parts of the body** instead of a possessive: *He took me **by the** arm. She hit him **on the** head.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~The Russian is a difficult language.~~ → **Russian** is a difficult language.
- ~~I go to the work by the bus.~~ → I go to **work** by **bus**.
- ~~It was the such good film.~~ → It was **such a** good film.
structure:
## Нулевой артикль
| Ситуация | Артикль | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| общее, мн. число | - | **Dogs** need exercise. |
| общее, неисчисляемое | - | **Water** is essential. |
| абстрактное понятие | - | **Freedom** is important. |
| приём пищи | - | We had **lunch** early. |
| время суток | - / the | at **night**; in **the** evening |
| времена года | - / the | in **summer** / in **the** summer |
| дни, месяцы | - | on **Monday**, in **April** |
| язык | - | She speaks **Spanish**. |
| титул + имя | - | **Professor** Lee |
| транспорт by | - | by **car** |

## Место по назначению
| Назначение (без the) | Здание / место (the) |
|---|---|
| She's **in hospital**. | I visited **the hospital**. |
| He's **at school**. | I went to **the school**. |
| They're **in prison**. | We drove past **the prison**. |
| He goes to **church**. | We walked to **the church**. |

## Порядок слов
| Слово | Схема | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| such | such + a/an + (adj) + noun | **such a** good idea |
| quite | quite + a/an + noun | **quite a** surprise |
| rather | rather + a/an + noun | **rather an** odd name |
| what | what + a/an + noun | **What a** day! |
| half | half + a/an | **half an** hour |

items.text: He goes to {{-}} work by {{-}} train every day.
I met her on {{the|a}} bus yesterday.
My brother is in {{-}} prison for a crime he did not commit.
I usually have {{-}} breakfast at seven.
{{-}} Russian is spoken in many countries.
We usually go skiing in {{-|the}} winter.
I phoned her at {{-}} night, but nobody answered.

exercises.title: a/an, the или нет артикля?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **a, an, the** или **-** (если артикль не нужен).

items.text: It was such {{a}} good film that I watched it twice.
She read about it in {{the}} Guardian.
He took me by {{the}} arm and led me away.
It was quite {{a}} surprise to see you here.
We have {{a|-}} deep respect for his work.
{{-}} President Lincoln was born in Kentucky.

items.why: Общее понятие без артикля: Hard work.

items.q: It was ___ surprise to see her there.
items.why: quite + a/an + существительное: quite a surprise.

items.q: We had ___ dinner you cooked last night. It was delicious.
items.why: Определение you cooked last night делает предмет конкретным: the dinner.

options: He's in the hospital for a week.

exercises.title: Исправьте ошибки с артиклями
exercises.instruction: В каждом предложении есть ошибка с артиклем. Перепишите предложение верно.

items.prompt: The life is full of surprises.
answers: Life is full of surprises.

items.prompt: She goes to the work by the bus.
answers: She goes to work by bus.

items.prompt: The Russian is my native language.
answers: Russian is my native language.

items.prompt: It was a such interesting lecture.
answers: It was such an interesting lecture.

items.prompt: We have the dinner at seven.
answers: We have dinner at seven.
I waited for half an hour.
I waited for a half hour.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение со словами в скобках и нужными артиклями (если они нужны). Добавьте недостающие слова.

items.prompt: (he / be / in / prison / for / five years)
answers: He is in prison for five years.
He's in prison for five years.
He was in prison for five years.
I go to bed at midnight.
I went to bed at midnight.
What a wonderful surprise!
What a wonderful surprise
What a wonderful surprise it is!
What a wonderful surprise it was!
She took me by the arm.
She takes me by the arm.
She's taking me by the arm.
She is taking me by the arm.

items.prompt: (I / go / to / work / by / bike / every day)
answers: I go to work by bike every day.
I went to work by bike every day.
Love is more important than money.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, следя за артиклями.

items.prompt: Как вы обычно добираетесь до работы или учёбы? (by ...)
items.sample: I usually go to work by bus.

items.prompt: Что вы обычно едите на завтрак? (have breakfast)
items.sample: I usually have breakfast at seven and eat porridge.

items.prompt: Какое время года вы любите больше всего? Почему?
items.sample: I like spring because the weather is mild and everything is green.

items.prompt: Что для вас важнее всего в жизни? (общее понятие без артикля)
items.sample: Family is more important to me than money.
